# Prince Bhagat

> Portfolio of Prince Bhagat, a cybersecurity student in Kathmandu, Nepal.

This site presents Prince Bhagat's cybersecurity learning, skills, experience, projects, education, certificates, and contact links.

## Portfolio sections

- [Home](https://princebhagat.com.np/#home): Introduction and resume.
- [Skills](https://princebhagat.com.np/#skills): Current technical skills.
- [Experience](https://princebhagat.com.np/#experience): Community and practical experience.
- [Projects](https://princebhagat.com.np/#projects): Public projects and security learning profiles.
- [Education](https://princebhagat.com.np/#education): Education background.
- [Certificates](https://princebhagat.com.np/#certificates): Courses and certificates.
- [Contact](https://princebhagat.com.np/#contact): Contact and social links.
